scenarios.title: Mailbox Sync & Ingestion Pipeline
scenarios.description: Step-by-step verification of an incoming email sync: from frontend trigger to Google API fetch, HTML sanitization, SQLite persistence, and UI event notification.

steps.title: Frontend Trigger
steps.description: User clicks 'Sync Mailbox' or automated interval triggers in Svelte UI.
steps.explanation: Wails IPC serializes the request into a JSON-RPC message over webview IPC.

steps.title: IPC Dispatch & Mutex Check
steps.description: Backend `App.SyncMailbox` executes, acquiring `syncMu` to prevent duplicate parallel syncs.
steps.explanation: `syncMu.Lock()` ensures only one sync job runs per account, preventing database lock contention.

steps.title: Background Goroutine Spawn
steps.description: `SyncEngine.SyncMailbox` is launched in a background goroutine.
steps.explanation: Goroutine runs asynchronously so the desktop UI remains responsive at 60fps.

steps.title: HTML Sanitizer & Tracker Strip
steps.description: Raw MIME body is processed by `SanitizeEmailHTML` to strip 1x1 tracking pixels and dangerous scripts.
steps.hazardAlert: ⚠️ Regex Sanitizer Warning: Complex nested markup can bypass regex filters.
steps.explanation: Email tracking pixels from SendGrid and HubSpot are removed before writing to disk.

steps.title: SQLite Parameterized Insert
steps.description: Clean message is inserted into SQLite messages table with FTS5 index update.
steps.explanation: All values bound with parameterized `?` placeholders, preventing SQL injection.

steps.title: Wails Event Notification
steps.explanation: Svelte store receives the event reactively and updates the inbox list with zero DOM flicker.

scenarios.title: Malicious HTML Email & Sanitizer Bypass Audit
scenarios.description: Audits how the sanitizer handles malicious HTML containing obfuscated XSS payloads and tracker pixels.

steps.title: Untrusted Ingestion
steps.description: Incoming email arrives containing tracking pixel `` and nested `ipt>` tag.
steps.explanation: Untrusted MIME body from internet payload enters system.

steps.title: Regex Tracker Filter
steps.description: `imgTagRegex` detects 1x1 image and replaces with placeholder.
steps.explanation: Tracking pixel pattern matched against known ESP domains.

steps.title: Nested Script Tag Bypass Check
steps.description: Evaluating regex single-pass script removal against `<scr<script>ipt>`.
steps.hazardAlert: 🚨 CRITICAL SECURITY VULNERABILITY: Single-pass regex stripping leaves inner `<script>` intact after outer tag is removed.
steps.explanation: In regex: `strings.ReplaceAll(s, '<script>', '')` converts `<scr<script>ipt>` into `<script>`. A proper AST tokenizer must be used.

scenarios.title: Concurrent Multi-Account Switching & Map Race
scenarios.description: Simulates parallel goroutines performing account switching while background sync is writing to shared maps.

steps.title: Background Sync Active
steps.description: Goroutine #1 is syncing Account A and executing `a.clients["a@domain.com"] = service`.
steps.explanation: Goroutine writes to map without holding `syncMu` or `mu`.

steps.title: User Clicks Switch Account
steps.description: Main thread receives UI click and calls `App.GetAccounts()` which reads `len(a.clients)`.
steps.hazardAlert: 💥 FATAL RUNTIME PANIC: `fatal error: concurrent map read and map write`
steps.explanation: Go runtime detects concurrent map access without synchronization and crashes the entire application process immediately.
